use_cases: Creates a continuous animated trail effect along an element's border using CSS mask and motion primitives
Wraps any container component to add visual polish and draw attention to specific UI sections
Provides a subtle decorative effect that enhances card, button, or modal borders without user interaction
ai_summary: A lightweight motion primitive component that generates an animated border trail effect around any container. Built with motion/react, it uses CSS mask-clip and offset-path properties to create a continuous moving highlight along border edges. The component is non-interactive and purely decorative, ideal for adding subtle visual interest to UI elements in SaaS, e-commerce, or media applications.
